notes.title: v 0.7.5 Update
notes.content:
Changelog:
- Added more words
- Added Mixer Streaming game mode
- Improved animation for showing the correct word
- Added Swedish language
- Removed the grip button as input on Oculus
- Added a play again option in the gallery
- Revised inventory screen and icons
- Added sound feedback to several character puppets
- Several fixes to wordcard icons and quick inventory
- Bug fixes

Mixer Game Mode
Play with up to 12 players online using Mixer. In this game mode a single Puppet Master can host a Puppet Fever session and play in real time with friends using Mixer. The audience players will type guesses as they join the game from mixer.com, an Xbox One or the Mixer app for smartphones.

notes.title: 0.7.1 Update: Mixer Chat and dedicated Puppet Master!
notes.content:
Changelog:

- Added Mixer chat support in VR, play over livestream!
- Mixer chat does not yet support emotes, but we're working on it.
- Added dedicated Puppet Master mode (no player swapping, perfect for livestreams!)
- Expanded options in game setup.
- Feedback on some menu buttons.
- Tweaked scaling of some puppets.
- More frequent intermissions during long games.
- Added additional info signs regarding controllers.
- Changed the font on info signs in order to improve readability in VR.
